music.title: Music bible
music.descriptionVideo: One LLM-authored song built from the creative brief, ready to edit, generate and turn into a videoclip. No MiniMax music credits are used until you generate audio.
music.descriptionStory: LLM-authored ambience, character presentation themes and three story songs. Suggestions cost no MiniMax music credits until you generate audio.
music.newSongPrompts: Generate prompts for a new song
music.newSongAudioTitle: Creates new prompts and lyrics and immediately generates a song with MiniMax
music.minimaxKeyTitle: Configure the MiniMax key in Settings → Services
music.newSongHint: “Prompts” does not generate audio. “New song” rewrites prompt and lyrics and launches a new version automatically; previous songs are kept.
music.music30Unavailable: MiniMax Music 3.0 · unavailable to new accounts
music.oneResultHint: One audio result per proposal and click. Repeating a cue adds another candidate without deleting the previous one.
music.minimaxReady: MiniMax is configured. Audio generation is available and always remains explicit.
music.minimaxMissing: Configure the shared MiniMax key in Settings → Services before generating audio.
music.rewriteAllTitle: Create a new version of every music proposal
music.rewriteAllHint: Changes style, language, or both. Prompts and lyrics are rewritten sequentially; generated audio candidates are never deleted.
music.newStylePlaceholder: Rap, boom bap, female flow, dark bass…
music.exampleSongHint: The LLM uses only high-level tempo, instrumentation and emotional architecture; the resulting melody and wording must be original.
music.desiredStyle: Desired style + Story role · editable LLM input
music.durationHint: MiniMax has no exact duration setting; this guides the LLM’s lyric length, while the rendered track can vary with tempo and arrangement.
music.adaptPromptLyrics: Adapt provider prompt + lyrics with LLM
music.newStyleExample: New style, e.g. cinematic rap / boom bap…
music.leaveEmptyHint: Leave either field empty to retain its current value. Existing generated tracks remain available below.
music.minimaxRequestHint: HocusPocus sends style and lyrics as separate fields. Editing these fields changes the next request.
music.promptHint: Genre, mood, instruments, voice, tempo and production. Anything after character 300 is not sent.
music.translateHint: Uses the selected Story Lab LLM and replaces these editable lyrics. MiniMax section tags stay unchanged.
music.missingTags: These lyrics have no supported section tags. Use the LLM adaptation or add [Verse], [Pre Chorus], [Chorus], [Bridge] and [Outro] before generating.
music.inspectPayload: Inspect the complete HocusPocus → MiniMax payload
music.lyriaHint: The LLM prepares the prompt here. Copy it to Google AI Studio, generate there, then import the MP3 result.
music.lyriaPlaceholder: Generate provider prompts with the LLM to create a timed composition breakdown…
music.lyriaDurationHint: Uses contiguous timestamps, section names, intensity, arrangement and separated lyrics. Lyria Pro targets up to about 3:00; longer Story durations are condensed in this prompt.
music.openLyria: Open Lyria in Google AI Studio
music.emptyHint: Generate the complete Story or click “Generate LLM suggestions” here. No MiniMax music credits are used at this stage.
music.manualTitle: Manual song / cover and musical trailer
music.manualHint: The original free-form workflow remains available for a custom song outside the LLM suggestions.
music.finalPrompt: Final MiniMax prompt · English · max 300 characters
music.manualTranslateHint: Uses the selected Story Lab LLM and replaces the editable lyrics, preserving MiniMax section tags.
music.manualNewVersion: Create a completely new manual version
music.manualVersionHint: Use either field or both. The current draft supplies the Story meaning, but its arrangement and sung lines are rebuilt from scratch.
music.manualDurationHint: MiniMax Music does not expose an exact duration parameter; the target guides lyric writing and the render can vary.

trailer.title: Cinematic trailer creator
trailer.description: Turn this Story’s canon into ordered clips that tell an epic mini-story: introduction, threat, escalation, breath and a final hook that does not reveal the ending.
trailer.narrativeHint: Everything is editable before opening Director or spending credits.
trailer.titleCards: Minimal cards: hook, title and tagline
trailer.titleCardsHint: Never turns dialogue into subtitles. Requires “Allow visible text” on the Story.
trailer.allowClipText: Allow visible text on this Story
trailer.timelineHint: Seconds are recalculated when duration changes.
trailer.clipProductionHint: Uses the same recoverable assembly pipeline: ordered clips, Play all, edit/regenerate in place and a final join.
trailer.visualGuideHint: Choose generated frames, approved references or pure text without images.
trailer.t2vDisablesConsistency: Choosing pure T2V will turn off strict protagonist visual consistency, because no images will be sent.
trailer.refsReady_one: {{count}} approved reference will be sent directly to H3; no start frames will be generated.
trailer.refsReady_other: {{count}} approved references will be sent directly to H3; no start frames will be generated.
trailer.approveInAssets: Approve at least one image in Assets before generating.
trailer.h3Required: Choose a MiniMax H3 model; Ref2VA is not available with other models.
trailer.t2vTitle: Pure T2V · no images or references
trailer.t2vHint: Director will repeat this visual contract in every clip and only add the trailer’s concrete situation.
trailer.masterPlaceholder: Define the world, characters and style that must repeat in every clip
trailer.t2vReady: The image model will not run and no references will be sent to H3.
trailer.styleFromMaster: In T2V the style comes exclusively from the master prompt.
trailer.styleKeepsMedium: Keeps medium, palette, design and approved references.
trailer.generationHint: Complete generation creates a recoverable job. “Start images” consumes image and video; Ref2VA and pure T2V skip the image model.
trailer.arcImpactDetail: An image, sound or line that opens a question.
trailer.arcEscalationDetail: Causal montage, visual variety and rising rhythm.
trailer.arcBreathDetail: Intimate contrast or a near-silent drop.
trailer.arcHookDetail: The strongest image or line, without resolving the story.

productions.title: Productions
productions.descriptionStory: Adapt the same approved material without destroying the source story.
productions.descriptionOther: Review the models, format and approved references before starting Director.
productions.comicHint: Creates a self-contained chapter inside the master canon. Director receives every arc, relationship, location and approved identity image.
productions.plannedSize: Planned size: {{count}} panels. Longer chapters take proportionally more planning time and image credits.
productions.comicCompleteHint: Complete generation creates the plan and artwork and may consume provider credits. Director mode lets you review every field first.
productions.quickHint: Turns the concept, dialogue and 3–8 moments directly into an assembled video, keeping leads, place and style.
productions.filmHint: Creates a short narrative episode instead of compressing the whole story. The cast, world and visual references remain attached.
productions.t2vNoRefs: T2V · no references or start images
productions.t2vNoImage: Text-to-video mode: no image model, start image or visual reference is required.
productions.approveInAssets: Approve at least one image in Assets.
productions.chooseH3: Choose a MiniMax H3 video model.
productions.notUsedDirectVideo: Not used in direct-video mode; the clip is generated from the text prompt alone.
productions.notUsedDirectRefs: Not used in direct-reference mode; approved Story images go straight to H3 Ref2VA.
productions.minimaxImageReady: MiniMax Image-01 runs through the external API and does not use local VRAM. It is independent from the local H3 video model.
productions.minimaxImageMissing: Add the MiniMax API key in Settings → Services before starting complete generation.
productions.localImageHint: Generates every shot frame locally with the selected HocusPocus image model.
productions.inheritedProfile: Inherited from the global production profile. Choose “Override in this project” above to edit it only for this Story.
productions.h3LegacyHint: H3 Legacy Quality uses its 20-step ConvRot recipe. A 7–10s shot at 720p can take tens of minutes even on an RTX 4090; choose 540p/480p or a Turbo-capable H3 variant when speed matters.
productions.h3Hint: MiniMax H3 renders every planned shot locally at up to 768p with native stereo audio. Longer shots are continued and assembled automatically.
productions.ltxHint: LTX uses HocusPocus’s multi-shot Director pipeline and requires its bundled Gemma 3 12B text encoder. Gemma may download on first use; it is an LTX dependency, not a separate setting. This choice is saved only in this Story.
productions.preserveStyleHint: Keeps anime, comic, illustration, palette and character design across generated frames and video. Disable only to intentionally reinterpret the adaptation.
productions.completeHint: Complete generation launches a recoverable Director pipeline and may consume image/video credits.
productions.musicVideoHint: Selects an existing Story song and builds the visuals around what that cue represents. Character themes keep that character and approved identity references at the center.
productions.howToGenerateHint: Choose generated frames, approved references sent directly through H3 Ref2VA, or pure text without any image.
productions.fixedProtagonist: Fixed-protagonist mode needs images: use “With images” or “Direct with references”.
productions.refsRouted_one: {{count}} approved image will be routed by character/location labels directly into H3 Ref2VA. The image model is not run.
productions.refsRouted_other: {{count}} approved images will be routed by character/location labels directly into H3 Ref2VA. The image model is not run.
productions.approveBeforeGenerate: Approve at least one image in Assets before generating.
productions.h3OnlyMode: Choose a MiniMax H3 video model; this mode is unavailable for LTX and other start-frame models.
productions.useCurrentStylesTitle: Replace the custom prompt with the project’s current styles
productions.masterPlaceholder: This contract will be repeated in full in every clip and segment
productions.inheritReady: Updates automatically from Visual style and Character visual style. Editing it switches to Custom. No images or H3 references will be sent.
productions.customReady: Custom prompt: the LLM will only add the concrete situation. No images or H3 references will be sent.
productions.completeMasterOrStyle: Complete Visual style or write a master prompt here before generating.
productions.generationModelsHint: These exact choices are sent to Director and saved with this music-video production for later iterations.
productions.imageUnusedRefs: Does not create start frames: it only sends the approved references directly to H3 Ref2VA.
productions.imageUnusedT2v: No image will be generated, loaded or sent.
productions.inheritedStoryOnly: Inherited from the global production profile. Choose “Override in this project” above to make a Story-only selection.
productions.h3LegacyMusic: H3 Legacy Quality renders 20 full quality steps per shot. At 720p this can take tens of minutes; 540p/480p or a Turbo-capable H3 variant is the faster choice.
productions.ltxGemma: LTX also downloads/loads Gemma 3 12B as its required text encoder. Gemma is not another selected model.
productions.h3SavedStory: This exact MiniMax H3 selection is saved only in this Story and sent to Director when production opens.
productions.configurePlanningLlm: Configure the selected planning LLM in Settings → Services before generating.
productions.defineMaster: Define the direct-video master prompt before generating.
productions.approveLibrary: Approve at least one image in the visual reference library.
productions.directRefsNeedH3: Direct references require a MiniMax H3 video model.
productions.configureMinimaxImage: Configure MiniMax in Settings → Services before using MiniMax Image.
productions.allowClipTextHint: If this is off, lyrics only guide rhythm, performance and visual meaning; they are never copied as text inside the shot.
productions.saveT2v: The selected song, structured lyrics, direct-video master prompt and pacing are saved in Adaptation history. Images remain in the Story library but are not sent to this production.
productions.saveRefs: The selected song, structured lyrics, approved custom references and pacing are saved in Adaptation history. H3 Ref2VA receives them directly without generating start images.
productions.saveImages: The selected song, structured lyrics, focus character/world, approved images and pacing are saved in Adaptation history and can be reopened independently.
productions.noSongs: No generated or imported songs are available yet.
productions.noSongsHint: to generate with MiniMax or import a Google Lyria result.
productions.hiddenTrailerHint: Turns the Story into a song-led video. HocusPocus analyzes the selected track’s duration, BPM, sections and beats, then plans cuts to fit the complete song.
productions.coverLimits: MiniMax accepts 6 seconds–6 minutes and up to 50 MB. Leave final lyrics empty to retain/extract the original, or provide your editable Story lyrics below.
productions.sourceLyricsPlaceholder: Optional source lyrics / section structure to adapt into this Story…
productions.adaptLyricsAuto: Adapt lyrics automatically to this Story
productions.adaptLyricsHint: Creates new wording from the Story while preserving only broad structure and singability. Use source material you are allowed to adapt.
productions.generateCovers: Generate {{count}} covers with MiniMax Music Cover
productions.configureMinimaxCandidates: Configure MiniMax in Settings → Services to generate candidates.
productions.optionalAce: Optional local generation is also supported through Director’s internal ACE-Step engine; it can be selected instead of MiniMax without changing the video workflow.
productions.useSongInTrailer: Use this song in musical trailer
productions.uploadedSongsHint: Uploaded songs work too. Beat-aware cuts synchronize editing rhythm; generated motion itself is not guaranteed to hit every beat semantically.
productions.missingOne: One section still needs review before generating.
productions.missingMany: {{count}} sections still need review before generating.
productions.directVideoReviewHint: You are in direct video: only texts and descriptions are approved; you do not need to generate or select images.
productions.reviewHint: Open each pending item, review its content and press Approve. Approving does not generate anything.
productions.assemblyHint: Open them in order, play them in full and replace clips from their position.
